task: Replace generic red faction fabric and paint with the existing nation-frame color; preserve the Unit illustration style, composition and text.
scope: Source PNGs in art/cards/units only. Poland remains red and unchanged. Rider badges intentionally remain 7 per the user's color-only choice.

cards.prompt:
Perform a precise COLOR-ONLY edit of the supplied existing finished Unit card. Preserve its original art style, illustration, character/equipment design, pose, anatomy, facial features where present, layout, camera, size and background exactly. This is not a new illustration.
The card's nation already has a distinctive color in the outer frame and score shield. Apply that same nation-color family to the subject's faction fabrics and painted faction panels so nation can be read from the main illustration at a glance.
Recolor ONLY the current red/crimson/burgundy faction cloth or painted details: tunic/tabard, sleeves, cloak, surcoat, horse caparison and saddlecloth, painted shield sections, banner/pennant cloth, or the battering ram's red canvas canopy stripes where those are visible. The nation color specified below must become the clearly dominant faction color in the SUBJECT. Existing cream/white panels remain cream/white, preserving the original patterns. If a hood or cloak is already green/brown and belongs to the faction outfit, align its fabric with the target color so the outfit is coherent; keep leather quivers and straps brown.
Keep natural highlights, shadows, folds, scuffs and weathering within the new fabric hue. Maintain material separation: steel remains silver, wood remains wood, leather remains brown, hair/skin and horse coat stay unchanged. Do NOT recolor red-tiled rooftops, flowers, warm rust spots on metal, or background objects. Never tint the whole image.
INVARIANTS: preserve original gold frame, colored border and score shield, numeric value, nationality label, bottom class name, typography, symbols, frame corners, all scenery, sunlight, clouds, terrain and foreground exactly. Do not add or remove objects, emblems, words or ornaments. Keep the same clean inked and painted medieval illustration technique, crisp edges and saturated but natural colors. No film grain, no new glow, no style change, no vignette, no image crop.
Return ONE complete card at the same 2:3 portrait dimensions and same full-frame alignment. Change faction fabric/paint COLOR only.
